title: Strategy Not Available
paragraphs: “What’s this one like?”
“Umm… it’s saying, ‘After I finish my work, I want to become a different kind of monster and get even stronger,’ nano.”
“Whoa, is it lamenting its own species…?”
“Monsters can do that when they class up, so it’s good to grant that wish, nano.”
“I don’t know how I feel about that… but for now, shall we take it to Rat?”
“Yeah. With this level of responsiveness and potential strength, the research should progress, right?”
“Yeah. If they say it didn’t work after all this, I wouldn’t know what to do…”
“It’s not an urgent matter, so it should be fine.”
With that, we quickly finished raising it and took the Soul Vacuum to the physician. The physician seemed to be talking with the Soul Vacuum for a while.
“As expected of the Four Holy Heroes. It looks like you brought exactly what we were asking for. Now, shall we go to that suspicious young lady as part of the experiment?”
“Huh? Already?”
“We’re ready on our end.”
Then, the physician attached something like a collar and a compressor-like device to the Soul Vacuum. For some reason, I’m feeling a bit excited.
“Alright, I’ll contact Rollick and have him lure out the suspicious young lady…”

And so, quite smoothly, the plan was set into motion. We were hiding in the barracks where the knights of Faubrey stay… near a forest managed by the country. It was a training ground a little distance away from Faubrey’s castle.

The knights were bringing a pig along, and… from the looks of it, they were casually chatting while dealing with the pig. I don’t really want to watch, but I’m curious about where the pig’s gaze is directed. From my perspective, it’s only looking at the ones I’d consider good-looking. There must be some sort of standard. It’s not even glancing at anyone else.

And among Rollick’s childhood friends, one of them seems to be completely ignored. Their face… well, I wouldn’t say it’s bad from my point of view. A bit on the rugged side, but they seem like a decent person.
“So? How’s it looking?”
The Soul Vacuum responds to the questions from the physician and Father with a soundless sound.
“Hmm, I see…”
The physician nods.
“Nano?”
Rival tilts her head as she watches. Assistant narrows his eyes.
“What’s the verdict?”
“Um… it looks fine at first glance, but… it’s saying the color changes partway through.”
Assistant answers Father.
“So, that means it’s black?”
“Then, it’s destroy time.”
When I grabbed the spear, Ren and Itsuki tried to stop me. What are you doing?
“Alright, here we go.”
The physician flipped the switch on some device with a snap. The Soul Vacuum seemed to twitch slightly with a faint crackling sound.
Oh? It’s starting to move actively now. Then, it emitted something again.
“It says it can see the seams and the places where things were forcibly coated, nano! Amazing, nano!”
This time, Rival stepped in as the interpreter.
“Has the accuracy improved… maybe?”
“It was still in the research stage. There’s a function that can temporarily enhance a monster’s abilities. But I wouldn’t recommend using it for too long.”
“So, what do we do? It’s saying it’s black, right?”
“I don’t think it’s entirely black… but…”
“We can deal with the next stage too. What should we do?”
“For now, let’s report to Rollick.”
Father stepped out from the bushes and called for Rollick and his group. The target pig seemed eager to follow, but one of the knights held it back.
“I just used a certain method to evaluate the soul, and… it looks really suspicious.”
“W-What…?”
The knight turned back toward the pig with a shocked expression.
“Oink!”
The pig tilted its head and let out a squeal. Then, the pig waved its hoof at me for some reason. Soon after, the pig that seemed to be Rollick’s companion came walking toward me.
“It’s whispering something like ‘the hidden character is here,’ but what is it talking about?”
“Hidden character… could it be Motoyasu-kun?”
Ren let out a sigh.
“What a crappy game.”
“Agreed. That character is completely impossible to beat for someone like him.”
“I’d rather just hand him over.”
“Seriously though, how are we supposed to beat him…?”
Impossible to beat? There’s no way a pig could ever ‘conquer’ me. I’ve already been conquered by Filo-tan. I would never, ever cheat.
“No matter what, there’s no route that leads anywhere. It’s a dead end with that woman.”
“According to Motoyasu-kun, maybe she came here before awakening to love? If that’s the case, there’s a slight possibility.”
“Or rather, that woman… she’s even glancing at us a little…”
“Oh, it looks like she noticed Ren. And Itsuki too… She’s trying to hide the aura, but… homo…”
Father is striking a strange pose. I don’t want to say it, but it’s a bit creepy. Even Father seems to realize it.
“Naofumi-san, what’s with that pronunciation…?”
“They say geeks recognize their own. That’s definitely black. Even if they try to hide it, you can tell. Just from the slight reaction, it’s obvious.”
Does she think no one’s watching her? Even when everyone looks away, her hands or her eyes give off slight hints at times. That’s why she gets found out.
“R-Really? I don’t get it at all… is she really doing something like that?”
“Yeah… I didn’t notice until it was pointed out.”
“Same here. Is she making some strange movements? I can’t sense anything beyond the words she’s using.”
“Well… it’s not even worth looking. She probably only sees me as a background character.”
“Hmm… so, does that mean Naofumi is outside her field of recognition?”
“Father’s face isn’t bad, I say.”

When comparing the four heroes, he may not stand out much, but if asked whether he’s good-looking or not, I’d say he’s on the better side. Maybe he doesn’t leave an impression because of his gentle eyes and slightly relaxed expression? The Father from the first world had a sharp intensity that even made my heart flutter.

“Motoyasu-kun, stop looking at me with those maiden-like eyes. So, Rollick-san. Our collaborator Rat-san said she can handle the next step. What do you want to do? We’re not demons. If we can prevent wrongdoing, we’re willing to put in the effort.”
“Please! Save the real princess!”
“She might already be dead, but are you okay with that?”
“Yes. I can’t stand the thought of someone manipulating her body and pretending to be her!”
“Understood. Then, heroes, order the Soul Vacuum to extract the soul. Aim properly.”
“Eh? O-Okay.”
Father pointed at the pig and ordered it to suck out the soul. The Soul Vacuum responded and began inhaling deeply.
“Bubuu!?”
The wind started to blow around us. Then, the pig stumbled and leaned against the wall. Was the wind that strong?
“Bubu… Bubububu!”
The pig seemed to be seeking help from the knight standing beside it.
“Eh? Eh?”
The knight, being appealed to, looked back and forth between us and the pig.
“Bubububu! Bububu!”
It seemed to be muttering something to try and stop it, but I couldn’t understand it. Was it begging for its life in pig language?
“Oh, I need to test this research item too.”
The physician took out several bluish-white magnifying glasses and handed them to us.
“Use this to look at the target.”
Following the instructions, we used the magnifying glasses to look at the pig. We saw something… a pig’s head was growing and trying to escape from the pig’s body. What is this?
